card.name: Linking words before purine drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (of, and, or, comma, to) right after azathioprine, mercaptopurine or thioguanine, where another purine-analog name or metabolite such as 6-MP is expected next.

modes.label: Link after purine drug
modes.description: A comma, 'and' or 'or' directly after a purine-analog drug or its metabolite.
modes.example: Mercaptopurine<< or>> Azathioprine Clinical Impact Allop

modes.label: Link before purine drug
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'to' just before a purine-analog drug or metabolite is named.
modes.example: Allopurinol inhibits xanthine oxidase mediated metabolism<< of>> mercaptopurine and azathiop

card.writes: It pushes the model toward word starts like 'pur' and 'nucle', as in purine and nucleoside terms.
card.plain: It fires on small joining words in sentences about azathioprine and mercaptopurine, just before another purine-type drug name.
